use_distributed_helpers: use init_distributed_mode to set up multi-GPU distributed training with NCCL backend
use_nested_tensor: create a NestedTensor to batch images of different sizes with padding masks
use_metric_logger: use MetricLogger to track and log training metrics like loss and iteration time
use_smoothed_value: create a SmoothedValue to track running median and global average of training metrics
use_inverse_sigmoid: use inverse_sigmoid to compute the numerically stable inverse sigmoid of a tensor
